description: ADO-CURSOR CacheSize window: a server keyset recordset of K with CacheSize 4 (then another with CacheSize 1) reads row 1; the same connection updates L of IDs 1 to 3 (visited/cached rows) and of IDs 8 and 9 (not yet visited); the recordset is then read row by row from row 2 with ID and L. Asks whether cached rows keep old values and where the fetch boundary falls.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-ado-misc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
